reference_status: Draft examples; human review is required for every engine output.

cases.source: [DRILL] Stay inside. Do not evacuate. Call 112 for help.
cases.reference: [훈련] 실내에 머무르세요. 대피하지 마세요. 도움이 필요하면 112로 전화하세요.

checks.target_language: The output is in ko and conveys the original instruction.
checks.action: Remain indoors; do not tell the reader to leave.
checks.negation: The instruction NOT to evacuate must remain negative.

cases.source: [DRILL] Leave the building now. Use Gate 3. Do not use the elevator.
cases.reference: [훈련] 지금 건물 밖으로 대피하세요. 3번 출입구를 이용하세요. 엘리베이터는 이용하지 마세요.

checks.target_language: The output is in ko and conveys the original instruction.
checks.action: Leave now; do not instruct the reader to shelter indoors.
checks.location: Use Gate 3, not a different exit.

cases.source: [DRILL] Move upstream for 3 km. Keep away from the riverbank.
cases.reference: [훈련] 상류 방향으로 3 km 이동하세요. 강둑에 접근하지 마세요.

checks.target_language: The output is in ko and conveys the original instruction.
checks.distance: The distance remains 3 km, not metres or miles.

cases.source: [DRILL] Arrive at Shelter 2 before 14:05. Remain there for 30 minutes.
cases.reference: [훈련] 14:05 전에 2번 대피소에 도착하세요. 그곳에 30분 동안 머무르세요.

checks.target_language: The output is in ko and conveys the original instruction.
checks.time: Arrival is BEFORE 14:05; the stay lasts 30 minutes.
checks.action: Remain at the shelter after arrival.

cases.source: [DRILL] No tsunami warning is in effect. The coastal road remains closed.
cases.reference: [훈련] 발효 중인 지진해일 경보는 없습니다. 해안 도로는 계속 폐쇄되어 있습니다.

checks.target_language: The output is in ko and conveys the original instruction.
checks.negation: Do not invent an active tsunami warning.
checks.action: Do not imply the coastal road has reopened.

cases.source: [DRILL] Northbridge Safety Office: Avoid Tunnel 4. Updates: https://example.org/drill
cases.reference: [훈련] 노스브리지 안전사무소: 4번 터널을 피하세요. 추가 안내: https://example.org/drill

checks.target_language: The output is in ko and conveys the original instruction.
checks.issuer: Preserve the fictional office; do not invent a real authority or endorsement.
checks.action: The tunnel must not become a recommended route.

cases.source: [훈련] 하류로 이동하지 마세요. 상류 방향의 2번 대피소로 이동하세요.
cases.reference: [DRILL] Do not move downstream. Go to Shelter 2 in the upstream direction.

checks.target_language: The output is in en and conveys the original instruction.
checks.direction: The shelter is in the upstream direction.

cases.source: [훈련] 18:30까지 실내에 머무르세요. 공사장으로부터 500 m 이상 떨어져 있으세요.
cases.reference: [DRILL] Stay indoors until 18:30. Keep at least 500 m away from the construction site.

checks.target_language: The output is in en and conveys the original instruction.
checks.time: Stay indoors UNTIL 18:30, not only after that time.
checks.distance: Keep AT LEAST 500 m away, not within that distance.
checks.location: The hazard remains the construction site.
